packageRules.description: Pinned after 2026-10 regressions: @codemirror/view 6.43.14 selectionchange crash with happy-dom, dayjs 1.11.22+ negative pre-epoch timezone offset, happy-dom 20.14 selectionchange dispatch. Re-evaluate deliberately, not via batch bumps.

Pinned to the vendored [patch.crates-io] copies and the Win7 WebView2 alignment comments in src-tauri/Cargo.toml; tauri/tauri-build/tauri-plugin* move in lockstep with that vendored stack — a registry tauri minor pulls wry/webview2-com/windows copies alongside vendor/ and breaks both Windows builds (#14049, #12000 rounds 1-8)

duckdb crate minor bumps bundle DuckDB engine releases (1.20000.1 = engine 2.0.0 with breaking Arrow streaming API changes); move it in a dedicated PR with source adaptation, not in the cargo minor/patch batch (#14049)

mysql_async is pinned to the zipg/mysql_async fork rev (Doris/EOF handshake patches); the fork publishes no version tags so renovate artifact updates always fail — bump the rev manually with the lockfile (#14049)
reqwest 0.13 renamed the rustls-tls feature to rustls/rustls-no-provider while 12+ manifests still request rustls-tls; 0.12.x keeps flowing and 0.13 needs a dedicated migration PR
0.x minor bumps are semver-breaking (RustCrypto digest wave, calamine, quick-xml, windows-core) and need source adaptation; keep them out of the cargo minor/patch batch (#12000)
Pinned 2026-11: vue-tsc 3.3.14 / @volar 2.4.30 surfaced 78 template '.value on boolean' type errors (#13677); re-enable only after the template ref typing cleanup in a single verified batch
Tauri npm packages must stay in lockstep with Rust crates; bump them manually with Cargo in one batch

Docs deps are pinned deliberately (fumadocs/lucide 2026-10-14 regression) and renovate's pnpm rewrites docs/pnpm-lock.yaml in a pre-10.34 patchedDependencies format that fails the frozen CI install; bump docs deps manually with pnpm 10.34.7 and a verified local build
Windows 7 agents build on Go 1.20.14 (Go 1.21+ requires Windows 10); their go.mod bumps stay manual (#11926 rounds 1-3)

golang.org/x/* and thrift releases now declare go 1.26 while agent-go CI and several release jobs stay on 1.23-1.25, and the go directive / setup-go go-version inputs must move only with a deliberate toolchain bump; re-enable per package once CI is on Go 1.26 (#11926, #11932)
pnpm comes from packageManager in package.json; the action-setup version input must not drift from it (#11932 rounds 1-6)

Action tool inputs (depType uses-with: go/rust toolchains, sccache, nightly pins) move only with deliberate toolchain bumps: Go 1.20.14 is the last Windows 7 release (#11926), sccache 0.19.0 breaks the win7 build-std rustc invocation with os error 206, and the nightly pin is keyed by WIN7_NIGHTLY_TOOLCHAIN for the prebuilt win7 artifacts (#13436). Verified from #14051's dependency table that these deps carry the literal depType 'uses-with' — both matchPackageNames [go, rust, sccache] and matchDepTypes [go, rust, sccache] failed to match them.
pnpm packageManager stays on the version the ci.yml action-setup steps pin (10.34.7); bump it manually together with those pins (#12479)
Nix hashes must be updated manually with the CI-computed value; renovate's local pnpm environment computes a different dbx-desktop-pnpm-deps hash
